text:
Aisha: Quick draft attached — rulebook for phasing private offers across AWS/GCP marketplace + HW partners. TL;DR: standard 3-phase lifecycle (pilot, ramp, sustained), commit bands, escrow triggers, renewal opt-ins. Want alignment from sales/finance/legal before we ship to marketplace teams. :eyes:

Eli: love the structure. question: where do we allow top-up credits during ramp?

Aisha: Proposed answer — allow 1x top-up within first 90d if utilization < 60% and customer commits to 12mo extension. See matrix below.

Marina: pinging finance — numbers look ok but need to formalize revenue recognition for escrow draws. +1 to top-up guardrails.

Jon: legal: need to add carve-outs for export-controlled HW and govcloud. Also standardize language for 'usage suspends' if over-commit but unpaid. I'll add clause.

Priya: revops: can we codify SKU mapping rules? we need exact SKU->offer mapping for marketplace reconciliation. example snippet: `SKU_MAP = { 'redwood-hosted': 'MPK-001', 'dedicated': 'MPK-DED-01' }`

Ken: product note: for community models vs licensed models we should have different discount caps. suggest gating quantization/hw-kicker for licensed models only.

Naomi (HW Partner, Orchid Labs): curious how escrow affects co-marketing credits? we typically need pre-funded co-marketing.

Olivia: partner-sales: Naomi — we can add a 'marketing reserve' line item that stays outside escrow but reduces effective usable credit.

Aisha: ok — we'll insert a 'marketing reserve' 5% of commit by default, configurable. Also added renewal trigger: if usage > 90% in last 60d, auto-propose renewal discount.

Aisha: attaching short matrix (text):

PHASE | DURATION | COMMIT BAND | TOP-UP | ESCROW DRAW
Pilot | 0-90d | 0-50k | allowed x1 | no draw
Ramp | 91-365d | 50k-500k | allowed x1 | conditional draw (util <60%)
Sustained | >365d | >500k | not allowed | standard monthly draws

let me know final edits by EOD Friday.

Eli: I'll take point on sales play and provide example customer email. :thumbsup: 

Priya: I'll prepare SKU mapping sheet and send sync invite.

Jon: legal will drop suggested phrasing by Monday.

Aisha: thanks everyone — moving to PR after comments.
